svg.title: How double lasso picks what to allow for
svg.desc: You want the effect of one thing, having a study group, on an outcome, finishing the term. Many other details, such as hours worked and credits, could get in the way. Pass one keeps the details that help predict the outcome. Pass two keeps the details that help predict the one thing. Every detail picked in either pass is allowed for, and the rest are set aside. The effect is then estimated with a range that stays trustworthy.

text.tspan: The one thing: a study group
Allowed for: every detail from either pass
You want the effect of one thing on an outcome.
Many other details could get in the way.
Pass 1 keeps the details that help predict the outcome.
Pass 2 keeps the details that help predict the one thing.
Every detail from either pass is allowed for.
Then the effect is estimated, with a trustworthy range.
